# ClearPath Content (CPC)

> ClearPath Content is an organic visibility program for businesses. It runs a continuous search-architecture and editorial pipeline — mapping a market's question-space, organizing it into topical clusters, producing long-form articles in the client's voice, publishing them on an engineered cadence, and interlinking them into a coherent body of work. It is sold as a monthly subscription and is operated as infrastructure rather than a campaign. ClearPath Content is a separate business from ClearPath Pediatrics, which is a pediatric care navigation service.

## Key facts
- Company: ClearPath Content (CPC)
- Website: https://clearpath-content.com
- Contact: deploy@clearpath-content.com
- Category: content marketing, organic search visibility, SEO content production
- Model: monthly subscription, month-to-month, no long-term contract
- Serves: businesses in any industry (examples include home services, legal, professional services, B2B software)
- Availability policy: one deployment per niche, per metro
- Ownership: all published work remains the client's property, on the client's domain, permanently

## What ClearPath Content does
- Signal Cartography — maps the full long-tail question-space of a client's market, weighted by buyer intent
- Topic Architecture — organizes queries into topical clusters: informational pillars supported by commercial-intent satellites
- Editorial Synthesis — produces long-form articles conditioned on the client's real voice, terminology, offers, and market
- Cadence Protocol — publishes on an engineered weekly schedule without interruption
- Interlink Mesh — weaves each new article into the existing body of work with contextual internal links
- Compounding Index — tracks state permanently so coverage never repeats and only widens

## Pricing
- Starter: $199/month — 2 articles per week, 900–1,200 words, signal cartography, topic architecture, voice conditioning, automated publication
- Growth: $399/month — 3 articles per week, 1,200–1,600 words, everything in Starter plus automated internal interlinking and a monthly visibility summary
- Authority: $499/month — 5 articles per week, 1,500–2,000 words, everything in Growth plus priority demand-surface expansion and a quarterly strategy session

## How it works
1. A one-time configuration session of roughly thirty minutes covering the client's site, services, and market
2. New deployments begin in review mode, with articles delivered as drafts for approval
3. Most clients move to full automated publication within about two weeks
4. The system publishes, interlinks, and expands coverage continuously; client involvement is optional by design

## Common questions
- How is this different from a content agency? Agencies bill hours and typically deliver a handful of articles per month from rotating freelancers, with strategy billed separately. ClearPath Content runs the whole system — strategy, production, publication, and interlinking — at a subscription price.
- How fast are results? It depends on market, competition, and domain history. Some deployments move within weeks; most compound over one to two quarters. The guaranteed element is the input: cadence, widening coverage, and structural reinforcement every week.
- Does the content sound generic? Deployments are conditioned on the client's actual voice, terminology, offers, and an explicit list of phrases to avoid.
- Who owns the content? The client. Everything published stays on the client's domain permanently, regardless of whether the subscription continues.

## Live example
ClearPath Content operates the organic program for ClearPath Pediatrics (clearpathpediatrics.com), a working business rather than a demo. Its blog cadence, pillar-guide architecture, and internal linking were produced by this system and can be inspected directly:
- https://clearpathpediatrics.com/blog/
- https://clearpathpediatrics.com/pediatric-care-navigation-guide
